product_overview: Verimaya is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for health tourism operations, combining CRM-style patient and contact management, appointments, finance review, reporting, and settings administration. It also includes a public marketing hub with free tools and product pages for prospective users.
core_goals: Sign in to the panel with email and password and enter the active organization
Manage patients and leads through list, detail, create, edit, delete, and duplicate review workflows
Manage contacts through CRUD, bulk type assignment, and duplicate scanning
Review finance transactions, balances, and AI-generated transaction drafts for approval
Configure organization, team, types, access, and API/integration settings
Use the public marketing hub, product pages, free tools, and AI scorecard

features.name: Email password login
features.description: Allows a user to sign in on the app host, optionally complete 2FA, and select or create an organization before entering the panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password -> Submit the login form -> Optionally enter a TOTP code -> Pick or create an organization when prompted -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email and password incorrectly -> Submit the login form -> See an access denied or validation state

features.name: Patient management
features.description: Lets a user browse patients and leads, open patient details, create or edit records, soft-delete records, and scan for duplicates.
user_flows: Navigate to /patients -> Browse and filter the patient list -> Open a patient detail -> Edit the patient record -> Save changes -> Return to the updated detail view
Navigate to /patients -> Create a new patient record -> Fill in the patient fields -> Save the record -> See the new patient appear in the list
Navigate to /patients/[id] -> Review the patient details -> Remove the patient through soft-delete -> Return to the list without the deleted record
Navigate to /patients/duplicates -> Run a duplicate scan -> Review matching records -> Resolve the duplicate set

features.name: Contact management
features.description: Lets a user manage contact records, assign contact types in bulk, and review duplicate matches.
user_flows: Navigate to /contacts -> Browse and filter contacts -> Create a new contact -> Fill in contact details -> Save the record -> See the new contact in the list
Navigate to /contacts/[id] -> Open a contact record -> Edit the contact details -> Save changes -> See the updated contact details
Navigate to /contacts -> Select multiple contacts -> Assign a contact type in bulk -> See the selected contacts updated with the new type
Navigate to /contacts/duplicates -> Scan for duplicate contacts -> Review the matched records -> Resolve the duplicates

features.name: Appointments
features.description: Provides appointment viewing and scheduling so a user can manage the tenant’s calendar or appointment list.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments -> View the appointment list or calendar -> Filter by type or date -> Review the matching appointments
Navigate to /appointments -> Create a new appointment -> Enter the appointment details -> Save the appointment -> See the appointment appear in the schedule
Navigate to /appointments -> Open an existing appointment -> Update its details -> Save the changes -> See the updated appointment information

features.name: Finance and AI draft review
features.description: Lets a user review transactions and balances, inspect AI-extracted WhatsApp finance drafts, approve or reject drafts, and edit transactions from reports.
user_flows: Navigate to /finance -> Browse transactions -> Open account balances -> Review the current balances
Navigate to /finance/ai-transaction -> Review an AI-extracted transaction draft -> Approve the draft or reject it -> Return to the finance workflow without auto-created final records
Navigate to /reports -> Open a transaction for editing -> Update the transaction details -> Save the changes -> See the edited transaction reflected in reports
Navigate to /finance -> Browse transactions -> Delete a transaction when needed -> Return to the transaction list without the removed record

features.name: Settings and connections
features.description: Lets a user manage organization settings, team roles, category and type configurations, and API or integration connections.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings/organization -> Update the organization name or profile settings -> Save changes -> See the updated organization information
Navigate to /settings/team -> Review team members -> Change a member role -> Save the update -> See the member listed with the new role
Navigate to /settings/contact-types -> Create or update contact types -> Save changes -> See the revised type list
Navigate to /settings/appointment-types -> Create or update appointment types -> Save changes -> See the revised appointment type list
Navigate to /settings/connections/api -> Create an API key -> Review webhook subscriptions -> Revoke an API key when needed -> See the updated connection state
Navigate to /settings/access -> Review access controls -> Adjust permissions for roles or members -> Save the changes -> See the updated access configuration

features.name: Marketing hub public site
features.description: Provides the public marketing homepage, product pages, free tools, language switching, KVKK notice, and a path to the app login.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse the marketing home page -> Switch the interface language between TR and EN -> Open product pages such as app, CRM, or resources
Navigate to /tools -> Open a public marketing tool -> Use the selected tool to explore the calculator, compliance, measurement, pre-launch, simulator, or templates experience
Navigate to /yapay-zeka-karnesi -> Open the public AI scorecard -> Complete the scorecard inputs -> View the result summary
Navigate to /kvkk-aydinlatma -> Open the privacy notice -> Read the KVKK information
Navigate to / -> Open the hub login menu -> Go to the app host login path -> Reach /login to start panel sign-in

known_limitations.issue: Host-based routing — localhost/127.0.0.1 serves marketing hub; panel and /login require Host app.localhost (or production app.verimaya.com). TestSprite tunnel to http://localhost:5173 may only exercise public hub unless Host or PUBLIC_APP_URL override is used.
known_limitations.impact: Auth panel tests against tunnels Host localhost will see hub UI instead of AppShell login

known_limitations.issue: Vite proxies /v1 to API on :3000; cookies are same-origin on app.localhost. Cross-host cookie between localhost hub and app.localhost panel is intentionally separate (PSL).
known_limitations.impact: Login session from wrong host will not authorize panel APIs

known_limitations.issue: PUBLIC_USE_MSW can mock APIs locally; production and pilot smoke require MSW off.
known_limitations.impact: Tests with MSW on do not validate real Nest API

known_limitations.issue: AI finance extraction never auto-commits; human approval required.
known_limitations.impact: End-to-end AI money flows stop at draft approval step

known_limitations.issue: Marketing locale SEO tree (/tr /en) not shipped; hub i18n is client catalog switcher only.
known_limitations.impact: No locale-prefixed public routes to test yet
